name: DeleteBlobFromContainer
label: Delete Blob from Container
description: Deletes a specified blob from the Azure Blob container.

fields.name: BlobContainerClient
fields.label: Blob Container Client
fields.description: The BlobContainerClient instance used to access the blob container.

fields.name: BlobName
fields.label: Blob Name
fields.description: The name of the blob to delete from the container.

fields.name: BlobWasDeleted
fields.label: Blob Was Deleted
fields.description: True if the blob was found and successfully deleted; false if it did not exist or deletion failed.
